# REL-19: Simulated Processors A and B with latency, decline-rate and outage controls

Status: **Done** | Phase 1 - Showcase slice | Owner: Claude | issue #10

## Outcome

Simulated Processors A and B with latency, decline-rate and outage controls

## Depends on

- [REL-12](REL-12.md) Monorepo skeleton and docker compose (Postgres, Redis, API and frontend hello-world) - Done

## Unblocks

- [REL-54](REL-54.md) Simulator: seed processor draws on the payment reference (ADR-0012)

## Acceptance

- [x] Authorize and capture endpoints per processor
- [x] Profiles configurable per processor; an outage can be switched on and off at runtime
- [x] Seeded runs are reproducible
- [x] Timeouts are a distinct injectable failure type alongside declines and outages
- [x] Authorize and capture accept an idempotency key (payment id and attempt); a repeated key returns the first result without a new outcome
- [x] Outcomes derive from the seed, payment id and attempt, not from arrival order (ADR-0009)
- [x] The control API (outage on and off, profiles) is separate from the processor API and requires the API key
- [x] Routes, bodies, responses and ports follow api-contract.md Simulator APIs (processor API 8100, control API 8101 with `X-API-Key`; profile body `latency_ms_p50`, `latency_ms_p95`, `decline_rate`, `timeout_rate`; `SIM_SEED` default 42; an injected timeout answers later than `PROCESSOR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`)

## Steps

1. **REL-19.1 Write failing simulator tests** (done) - Cover authorize and capture per processor, configurable latency and decline rate, runtime outage toggle, and identical results for the same seed.
2. **REL-19.2 Scaffold the simulator service** (done) - Add a FastAPI app under `simulator/processors/` with Processor A and B routes and a compose service.
3. **REL-19.3 Implement authorize and capture endpoints** (done) - Each processor approves, declines with a reason, or times out according to its profile. Repeated calls with the same idempotency key return the first result.
4. **REL-19.4 Add profiles and the runtime outage control** (done) - Configure latency and decline rate per processor via environment or the control API (API key required), and switch an outage on and off without a restart.
5. **REL-19.5 Make seeded runs reproducible** (done) - Derive each outcome from a hash of the seed, payment id and attempt so arrival order does not matter; a test replays a seed in a different order and compares outcomes. `sim-tests` pass.
6. **REL-19.6 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - CI is green, the reviewer confirms correctness against the requirements, the maintainer approves, and the pull request is squash-merged with the issue closed.
